records.exact_statement: For any nonempty finite free-boundary zero-field q-state Potts graph, q integer >=2, beta>=0, the favored-color centered pressure has P''=a2 E[S2]/N, P'''=a3 E[S3]/N, and P''''=(a4 E[S4]+3a2^2 Var(S2))/N at field zero.
records.assumptions: Free boundary; finite graph; uniform independent colors conditional on FK components; a2=(q-1)/q^2, a3=(q-1)(q-2)/q^3, a4=(q-1)(q^2-6q+6)/q^4.
records.proof_or_counterexample: Independently expanded conditional moments and subtracted 3(E X^2)^2; exact q=3 two-vertex enumeration gave cumulants 5/9,7/27,-8/27 on both spin and FK sides (before division by N).
records.remaining_gap: Finite-volume identity gives no uniform thermodynamic remainder or critical magnetization.

records.exact_statement: For finite FK with q>=1, p in (0,1), each edge conditional open probability given all other edges is either p or a=p/(p+q(1-p)); every fixed simple n-edge path has open probability in [a^n,p^n]. Positive local conditional probabilities alone do not imply infinite-cluster probability.
records.assumptions: Finite graph with arbitrary fixed FK boundary partition; chain rule for path; in the example Z^3, q=3,p=1/10.
records.source_quote: a^n <= P(all n path edges open) <= p^n.
records.proof_or_counterexample: Edge-weight ratio gives p or a. Tower property preserves bounds under partial exposure. Union over at most 2d(2d-1)^(N-1) paths gives f_N<=0.6(0.5)^(N-1) in the example. Exact C4 enumeration gives Z=258, marginal=11/43, all-open=1/86, ratio to product 2.71521754.
records.remaining_gap: Subcritical example does not address the critical q=3,d=3 case.

records.exact_statement: For wired FK on Z^d with q>=1, theta_w(p)=inf_N phi^w_{Lambda_N,p,q}(0 connected to boundary Lambda_N) is right continuous. A fixed positive lower bound on theta_w(p) for all p just above p_c therefore implies theta_w(p_c)>0.
records.assumptions: Standard finite-volume wired FK domain Markov comparison; p in (0,1); finite boxes increasing to Z^d.
records.source_quote: The same delta must survive the p-downarrow-p_c and N-to-infinity limits.
records.proof_or_counterexample: Finite-box f_N decrease in N and increase continuously in p. Infimum of f_N is upper semicontinuous; monotonicity gives right continuity. Inner-boundary event sandwiches the limiting f_N against infinite-volume theta_w.
records.remaining_gap: No uniform positive critical-window bound has been proved.

records.exact_statement: An S3-invariant scalar functional can have a fixed nonzero cubic term and still develop a continuous ordered minimizer if a nonanalytic r^(5/2) term dominates the cubic near zero.
records.assumptions: Functional F_t(z)=-t|z|^2+|z|^(5/2)-Re(z^3)+|z|^4 on C; this is an abstract functional, not a Potts lattice Gibbs potential.
records.proof_or_counterexample: With s=sqrt(r), 1-s+s^3>=1-2/(3sqrt(3))=:c>0, so t<=0 has unique zero minimizer and each t>0 minimizer has radius <=(t/c)^2, tending to zero.
records.remaining_gap: Does not decide C0048; it blocks an argument from cubic symmetry alone.
